---
title: "IMDb Rankings"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  table <- page |>
    html_table() |>
    pluck(1)

  rank_title_year <- str_match(
    str_squish(table[["Rank & Title"]]),
    "^([0-9]+)\\.\\s*(.*)\\s+\\(([0-9]{4})\\)$"
  )
  rating_tooltips <- html_elements(page, "td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")
  vote_counts <- str_match(rating_tooltips, "based on ([0-9,]+) votes")[, 2] |>
    str_remove_all(",") |>
    as.numeric()

  tibble(
    snap_year = snapshot_year,
    rank = as.integer(rank_title_year[, 2]),
    title = rank_title_year[, 3],
    year = as.integer(rank_title_year[, 4]),
    rating = as.numeric(table[["IMDb Rating"]]),
    number = vote_counts
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, fetch_snapshot) |>
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year == 2015) |>
  select(title, year, rank_2015 = rank) |>
  inner_join(
    imdb_snapshots |>
      filter(snap_year == 2022) |>
      select(title, rank_2022 = rank),
    by = "title"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year - year %% 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  )

print(
  rank_changes |>
    arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
    slice_head(n = 10)
)

print(
  rank_changes |>
    group_by(release_decade) |>
    summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(release_decade)
)
```

```{r}
decade_rank_changes <- rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(
      avg_rank_change > 0,
      "Rank number rose",
      "Rank number fell"
    ),
    release_decade = factor(release_decade)
  )

ggplot(decade_rank_changes, aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Rank number rose" = "#D55E00", "Rank number fell" = "#0072B2"),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Rank change = 2022 rank minus 2015 rank.\nHigher rank numbers indicate lower chart positions.",
    x = "Average rank change",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
snapshot_distribution <- imdb_snapshots |>
  group_by(title) |>
  summarize(snapshots = n_distinct(snap_year), .groups = "drop") |>
  count(snapshots, name = "film_count") |>
  arrange(snapshots)

print(snapshot_distribution)
```
